python3 - <<'PY'
import csv, json
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('/home/xu/project/loop/DeepScientist/quests/001')
eval_csv = root / 'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/TOKEN_WEIGHTED_EVAL.csv'
summary_path = root / 'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/LARGE_EVAL_SUMMARY.json'
manifest_path = root / 'experiments/stage10/07_large_eval/LARGE_EVAL_MANIFEST.json'
rows = list(csv.DictReader(eval_csv.open(newline='')))
summary = json.loads(summary_path.read_text())
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
target = [r for r in rows if r['source_endpoint_type'] == 'Y_recover' and r['training_budget_tokens'] == '100000000']
original = [r for r in rows if r['source_endpoint_type'] == 'original_reference']
by_model = Counter(r['model_id'] for r in target)
orig_by_model = Counter(r['model_id'] for r in original)
model_status = {model: v['status'] for model, v in sorted(summary['model_counts'].items())}
model_summary_rows = {model: v['row_count'] for model, v in sorted(summary['model_counts'].items())}
result = {
    'csv_rows_total': len(rows),
    'csv_statuses': sorted(set(r['status'] for r in rows)),
    'summary_status': summary['status'],
    'summary_evaluated_endpoint_rows': summary['evaluated_endpoint_rows'],
    'summary_expected_formal_endpoint_rows': summary['expected_formal_endpoint_rows'],
    'summary_total_table_rows_including_original': summary['total_table_rows_including_original'],
    'active_model_count': summary['model_availability']['active_entry_count'],
    'target_y_recover_100m_rows': len(target),
    'target_rows_per_model': dict(sorted(by_model.items())),
    'original_reference_rows': len(original),
    'original_reference_rows_per_model': dict(sorted(orig_by_model.items())),
    'summary_model_row_counts': model_summary_rows,
    'summary_model_statuses': model_status,
    'manifest_limit_endpoint_types': manifest['limit_endpoint_types'],
    'manifest_limit_budgets': manifest['limit_budgets'],
    'manifest_writes_Y_frozen': manifest['writes_Y_frozen'],
    'manifest_writes_Y_recover': manifest['writes_Y_recover'],
    'manifest_uses_training_batch_for_eval': manifest['uses_training_batch_for_eval'],
    'manifest_heldout_evaluator_freeze': manifest['heldout_evaluator_freeze'],
}
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
